DreamBot · master ad sheet

Every concept, one place.

The whole ad system, tabbed by type. Bot & Taco are the throughline (our Buzz & Woody), features are woven into their bickering, and the explainer ribbon keeps every ad legible. These are layout + copy mockups built with real app art to react to, not final renders.

the setup (for the crew)

Every DreamBot ad is secretly a buddy comedy.

The bit: one of them made the other, and the other has absolutely no idea. That gap is the whole joke, and every time they argue about it we get to smuggle in a real feature. The bot mentions it dreams for you nightly; the taco takes it as a personality trait (“I was BORN at 3am”). The bot explains it can run every major AI model; the taco assumes he went to culinary school.

Why it works as advertising: the humor and the cuteness stop the scroll, the banter carries the pitch so we never sound like a spec sheet, and the little explainer ribbon at the bottom catches anyone who still needs the “wait, what is this app?” in one second.

Voice cheat-sheet: dreamy, playful, a little cheeky. Bot is dry and deadpan; Taco is pure golden-retriever enthusiasm. Lowercase-casual for the jokes, no em dashes, and any ad can button on “Dream it. Make it.”

How to read this sheet: use the tabs. Bot × Taco is the throughline · Memes are borrowed formats · Face-Swap shows the actual product magic with real cast photos · Nightly leans on the wake-up-to-a-dream ritual · The Explainer is the badge system that keeps everything clear.

Bot × Taco

Our Buzz & Woody. The bot is the exhausted creator who runs everything; the taco is the creation who has no idea he isn’t real and just wants to play trombone. Every bit smuggles a real feature into the bickering. These are storyboards to render as real scenes of the two together.
